data.title: Magnifying lens
data.summary: Office aids · Hand lens (2x-7x), with or without its own light, for studying fine surface details of lesions.
data.body:
_Also called: Hand lens, Self-illuminating magnifier_

Hand lens (2x-7x), with or without its own light, for studying fine surface details of lesions.

## Types / variants
- Self-illuminating (built-in torch)
- Non-illuminating
- Magnification 2x to 7x

## Uses / indications
- Studying fine morphology of skin lesions
- Nits and lice (pediculosis capitis, pubic lice); lice in clothing seams (pediculosis corporis)
- Scabies burrows and mites
- Auspitz sign, nail pits, Wickham's striae (lichen planus vs lichenoid drug rash)
- Black dots in warts and black-dot tinea capitis
- Umbilication in molluscum, penicilliosis
- Carpet-tack sign in DLE, seborrhoeic keratosis, Darier's disease, pemphigus foliaceus
- Nail-fold telangiectasia in collagen vascular disease
- Furrow in the ridged margin of porokeratosis
- Exclamation-mark hairs in alopecia areata
- Can act as a diascope when no glass slide is available
